title: The Effect of Pachychoroidal Spectrum Disease on the Response to VEGF Inhibitor Therapy in Macular Neovascularization
summary:
Analysis of the Results Comparing Two
Treatments for a Macular Hole.

interventions.name: All patients with macular neovascularization due to AMD or pachychoroid who are receiving anti-VEGF therapy and have a median age of 40 years.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Macular neovascularization associated with AMD or pachychoroid under anti-VEGF therapy -
Minimum age: 40 years
- Signed informed consent form
Exclusion criteria:
- Other underlying conditions that significantly affect visual acuity or the response to treatment
(e.g., venous occlusion)
- Language or cognitive impairments that prevent the patient from
understanding the informed consent form
